sample_unit: respondents (5043 medical undergraduates and 190 radiology trainees)

links.outcome: Medical undergraduates' exposure to formal AI training and hands-on AI experience
links.effect: Most medical undergraduates reported limited exposure to formal AI training or hands-on experience; radiology trainees reported higher AI education and tool use. The abstract reports no numbers.
links.quote: Most medical undergraduates reported limited exposure to formal AI training or hands-on experience yet expressed general support for its clinical use.

unlisted_practices: Integrating structured AI training into undergraduate medical and radiology curricula

screen.reason: Multicenter survey evaluating knowledge, perceptions, attitudes, and readiness for AI in clinical practice among medical students and radiology trainees.
